title: Add RecipesFolderPicker UIViewControllerRepresentable
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipesFolderPicker.swift wrapping UIDocumentPickerViewController configured with forOpeningContentTypes: [.folder]. On selection, delegates to RecipesFolderStore.saveBookmark(for:). Cancellation leaves any prior store state unchanged. No third-party SwiftUI helper libraries — pure UIViewControllerRepresentable.
acceptance_criteria: On selection, calls RecipesFolderStore.saveBookmark(for:) with the picked URL
Cancellation does not modify RecipesFolderStore state

handoff_summary.completed: RecipesFolderPicker.swift implemented and confirmed to compile as part of the CookbookApp iOS target. All six acceptance criteria satisfied: file exists, conforms to UIViewControllerRepresentable, uses .folder content type, calls saveBookmark on selection, is a no-op on cancel, no third-party libraries.
handoff_summary.remaining: Nothing remaining for this bead. Downstream beads (FolderSetupView, RecipesListView, SettingsView integration) depend on this component being available.
handoff_summary.risks: None. The component is purely additive with no side effects at rest — it does nothing until presented.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the component integrates correctly when presented from a SwiftUI sheet or navigation destination with a live RecipesFolderStore.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low. This is a new file with no edits to existing files. No overlap with sibling beads expected.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Passed `RecipesFolderStore` as a `let` property (direct reference) rather than via `@Environment`, keeping the component self-contained and explicitly wired by the caller. Cancellation handled by omitting `documentPickerWasCancelled` — the delegate method simply doesn't fire, leaving store state untouched.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No unit-testable logic beyond the delegate callback. Integration test should confirm saveBookmark is called with the correct URL on selection and that store.folderURL remains nil when the picker is cancelled.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: UIDocumentPickerViewController only supports single selection in this implementation (uses urls.first). If multi-select were ever needed, the guard would need updating — but the spec requires single folder selection only.

conflict_risks: Low. This is a new file with no edits to existing files. No overlap with sibling beads expected.
